detector.name: DentiLens intraoral YOLOv8n tooth detector

dataset.label_policy: All source tooth classes, including 327 and 56, collapsed to tooth; no FDI numbering claim.
limitations: No patient identifiers available to audit patient overlap across splits.
Near-duplicate images with different basenames are not excluded by hash checks.
Enclosing boxes do not establish accurate tooth-boundary masks.

training.selection: best validation fitness; test split unused

limitations: Single tooth class; no FDI numbering.
Detection metrics do not measure SAM segmentation accuracy.
Intraoral still-image performance does not establish video accuracy.

clips.verification: Source hash, timing, mask assets and highlight geometry checked.
clips.qualitative_review: Inspected overlay at 15 seconds: masks on a few real front teeth. Only 3 of 43 sampled frames retained predictions. Visible teeth in inspected frames at 1 and 10 seconds were missed.

app_verification: AppTest exercised real upload persistence, inference subprocess and result rendering. File-picker and analyze-button inputs were substituted. Browser controls were inspected separately before a session interruption.
limitations: No annotated video ground truth or SAM mask-accuracy measurement.
Region counts include repeated teeth and are not comparable to group-mask counts from the text-guided baseline.
No per-clip threshold tuning, tooth numbering, action recognition or temporal tracking.
Raw footage and evidence images stay local.
decision: Do not replace the text-guided video baseline. Keep the trained detector explicitly experimental.
crop_experiment: Exploratory box-guided crops on three frames produced 1, 3 and 1 detector boxes, respectively; missed teeth and a non-tooth cavity-region box remained. Not adopted or used as a video-accuracy evaluation.
